It's been an awful week in the news for women (I guess every week is...) so I feel like sobbing with relief that one of the most powerful men in the world is facing justice for his abuse. 
The women who came forward did so at HUGE personal cost & they are amazing. 👏
#MeToo

If you can't understand why the vast majority of women don't report sexual assault, consider that it took 90+ women coming forward about Harvey Weinstein's abuse to result in just two guilty convictions. #MeToo 

(paraphrased from @AshleyJudd)
